# Is this fixed-price job going to finish inside the price?

> Free fixed-price project forecaster: enter price, cost budget, percent complete and cost to date to see projected final cost, margin, CPI and SPI, and when the job stops paying. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
